related.title: 蘭斯潮汐發電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「實際擷取的潮汐能比例」與「每潮的換水比例」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；蘭斯潮汐發電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Share of tidal energy actually captured" and "Water exchanged each tide" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of La Rance Tidal Power Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦借用既有海堤的世界最大潮汐電廠：實際擷取比例、水輪機流量、換水與閘門；蘭斯潮汐發電站則以運轉近六十年的第一座大型潮汐電廠：抽水增益、大小潮、潮時漂移與淤積為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest tidal plant on an existing seawall: share captured, turbine flow, water exchange and sluices; La Rance Tidal Power Station centres on the first large tidal plant, running nearly sixty years: pumping gain, springs and neaps, drift of tide times and siltation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「潮差蓄能」與「潮差蓄能」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「容量因數與可預測性」的模型移到蘭斯潮汐發電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「潮汐時刻的漂移」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy from tidal range" and "Energy from tidal range".
Move the model of "Capacity factor and predictability" to La Rance Tidal Power Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drift of tide times", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「實際擷取的潮汐能比例」與「每潮的換水比例」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；蘭斯潮汐發電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Share of tidal energy actually captured" and "Water exchanged each tide" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of La Rance Tidal Power Station must be respecified.

related.title: 梅根潮流能陣列
related.transfer: 可遷移「實際擷取的潮汐能比例」與「每潮的換水比例」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；梅根潮流能陣列的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Share of tidal energy actually captured" and "Water exchanged each tide" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of MeyGen Tidal Stream Array must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦借用既有海堤的世界最大潮汐電廠：實際擷取比例、水輪機流量、換水與閘門；梅根潮流能陣列則以放在海峽急流裡的渦輪機：大小潮的三次方、推力、憩流時窗、出口電纜與陣列密度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest tidal plant on an existing seawall: share captured, turbine flow, water exchange and sluices; MeyGen Tidal Stream Array centres on turbines set in a racing strait: the cube law at springs and neaps, thrust, slack-water windows, export cables and array density, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「潮差蓄能」與「潮流功率密度」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「容量因數與可預測性」的模型移到梅根潮流能陣列，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「出口電纜的損失」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy from tidal range" and "Power of a tidal stream".
Move the model of "Capacity factor and predictability" to MeyGen Tidal Stream Array, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Loss in the export cable", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「實際擷取的潮汐能比例」與「每潮的換水比例」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；梅根潮流能陣列的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Share of tidal energy actually captured" and "Water exchanged each tide" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of MeyGen Tidal Stream Array must be respecified.

history.title: 錫赫瓦潮汐發電站
history.text: 1994 年圍墾海堤完成；2004 年潮汐電廠工程開工；2011 年電廠正式啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1994: The reclamation seawall was completed. 2004: Construction of the tidal plant began. 2011: The plant opened. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
